title: Per-photo pixel observations of control points
description: 05 §2: a point's surveyed 3D coordinate (control_points.schema.json) and its per-photo 2D PIXEL measurements are stored in SEPARATE structures. This file holds only the 2D image measurements. Coordinates are in pixels; whether they are raw or undistorted is stated explicitly.

x_px.description: Pixel x in the photo grid

y_px.description: Pixel y in the photo grid

photo_undistorted.description: True if coords are in an undistorted/normalized plane rather than raw sensor pixels
